label: copy-phase fed-back q, when output is z/3/b/f/e/q/p
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost only when the fed-back input token is q (98.7% of activation mass; z, 3, b account for the rest). It never fires in the original or delimiter phase, or at recall_idx 0-1, and it peaks around recall_idx 3-4. Only about 13% of copy-phase q inputs fire. Whether it fires, and how strongly, depends on the token being output next: z gives the largest activations (top examples are q followed by output z), then 3, b, f, e, q, p. The predicate copy-phase q AND recall_idx>=2 alone gets recall 0.97 and mass recall 0.99 but precision 0.16. Adding the out_tok set gets dev F1 0.56 and mass recall 0.83. Weak firings on other out_tok values are missed, and many q->z/3/b... steps stay silent, so precision is still incomplete.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=q (+8.77), phase=2 & in_tok=z (+5.16), phase=2 & in_tok=3 (+4.63), in_tok=q (+3.98), phase=2 & out_tok=3 (+3.79), next_out=z (+3.73). Lower it: recall_idx=1 (-4.00), prev_tok=<DEL> (-4.00), out_tok=d (-3.34), next_out=u (-2.83).
